Helper to transform data frame for treemap/sunburst highcharts format

Source: R/helpers.R
data_to_hierarchical.Rd

Helper to transform data frame for treemap/sunburst highcharts format

Usage

data_to_hierarchical(data, group_vars, size_var, colors = NULL)

Arguments

data

data frame containing variables to organize each level of the treemap.

group_vars

Variables to generate treemap levels.

size_var

Variable to aggregate.

colors

Optional vector of colors for first-level groups, recycled as needed. With the default NULL, nodes inherit colors from the chart theme.

Examples

countries <- gapminder::gapminder |>
  dplyr::filter(year == 2007) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pop_mm = round(pop / 1e6))
nodes <- data_to_hierarchical(countries, c(continent, country), pop_mm)

hchart(nodes, type = "sunburst")


hchart(nodes, type = "treemap")
